label: Accountability
description: Clear assignment of responsibility for cybersecurity and risk decisions.

label: Acquire Securely
description: Acquire systems, services, components or resources with cybersecurity considerations built into procurement.

label: Acquisition and Supply-Chain Activity
description: An activity used to acquire securely, conduct supplier due diligence, obtain assurance or flow requirements through the supply chain.

label: Adverse Security Event
description: An adverse cybersecurity event affecting a capability, system, data or essential function.

label: Allocate Resources
description: Allocate time, authority, funding, personnel or support needed for cybersecurity activities.

label: Analyse Risk
description: Analyse identified cyber risks.

label: Anticipate Technological Change
description: Anticipate technological developments that could adversely affect essential systems.

label: Architecture
description: The capability or programme architecture that is reviewed, tested, evaluated and improved for cyber resilience.

label: Archival Management
description: Manage archival information/assets securely as part of through-life management.

label: Artefact Reference
description: A direct reference or link to a named programme assurance artefact.

label: Assessment
description: CADMID Assessment stage; used only where the requirement has a plausible assessment or acquisition applicability.

label: Asset
description: A tangible or intangible programme resource or object subject to management or protection.

label: Asset Management
description: Manage assets through life in line with MOD policy.

label: Assurance Evidence
description: An information-bearing artefact used to demonstrate, support, verify or review fulfilment of a cybersecurity expectation.

label: Assurance Security Practice
description: A security practice concerned with ongoing assurance, testing or verification.

label: Atomic Requirement Clause
description: An analytical clause-level obligation candidate decomposed from an official SbD requirement.

label: Attack Scenario
description: A plausible scenario describing how a threat actor may pursue an objective against the programme or capability.

label: Attack Method or Technique
description: A method or technique by which a threat actor could attack or analyse a system.

label: Availability
description: Availability or continuity of essential functions and information when needed.

label: Backup
description: A protected and tested copy or recovery resource used to support continuity or recovery.

label: Business Continuity
description: Maintain essential functions during disruption or incidents.

label: Business Continuity Plan
description: A plan for maintaining essential functions during disruption or incident.

label: CADMID Stage
description: A Concept, Assessment, Demonstration, Manufacture, In-Service or Disposal stage used to express MOD lifecycle applicability.

label: Capability
description: A delivered programme capability whose essential functions, risk, architecture, controls and through-life security are governed.

label: Capability Team
description: A team responsible for aspects of capability delivery and cybersecurity responsibilities.

label: Capture Lessons Learned
description: Capture and feed lessons from delivery, incidents or exercises back into programme and development practice.

label: Communicate Security Information
description: Communicate cybersecurity decisions, responsibilities, risks or information to relevant parties.

label: Compromise
description: Loss or degradation of security affecting a capability, data or essential function.

label: Concept
description: CADMID Concept stage; used only where the requirement has a plausible early lifecycle applicability.

label: Conduct Forensics
description: Perform tested forensic processes to develop a documented understanding of an incident.

label: Conduct Risk Assessment
description: Assess cyber risk using relevant threat, vulnerability, likelihood, impact and contextual information.

label: Conduct Root Cause Analysis
description: Identify root causes and impacts during post-incident analysis.

label: Conduct Threat Analysis
description: Analyse systems from a threat-actor perspective and anticipate probable attack methods.

label: Conduct Threat Assessment
description: Assess relevant cyber threats and maintain the assessment over time.

label: Confidentiality
description: Protection of information from unauthorised disclosure.

label: Context
description: Circumstances that shape programme and capability cybersecurity.

label: Contextual Concept
description: A mission, context, objective, expectation or operational state needed to interpret SbD requirements.

label: Continuous Assurance
description: Maintain assurance through recurring testing, monitoring, review and evidence across the lifecycle.

label: Continuous Risk Management
description: Maintain risk understanding and treatment as context, threats and technology change over time.

label: Contract
description: A contractual artefact used to acquire resources and impose security or risk-treatment provisions.

label: Cross-Lifecycle / Through-Life Context
description: A lifecycle context spanning multiple CADMID stages or explicitly described as through-life.

label: Cryptographic Protection
description: Use cryptographic mechanisms where appropriate to protect data.

label: Cyber-Resilient Architecture
description: Review and improve architecture to support resilient capability delivery.

label: Cyber-Resilient Design
description: Design capability components, support and resourcing with cyber resilience considered.

label: Cyber Risk Assessment
description: A structured assessment of cyber risk considering relevant threat, vulnerability, likelihood, impact and contextual information.

label: Cyber Security Strategy
description: A formally documented programme cybersecurity strategy based on organisational context and reviewed as threats and mission change.

label: Cyberattack
description: A cyber attack whose methods, techniques and impact on essential functions are considered.

label: Cybersecurity Decision
description: A decision relating to cybersecurity, risk or programme action informed by relevant information.

label: Data in Transit
description: Data while being transferred, including third-party transfers.

label: Data Inventory
description: A maintained record identifying programme data and supporting understanding of its location and handling.

label: Data Protection
description: Protect important data in transit and storage using appropriate safeguards.

label: Decision
description: A decision or approval that influences programme, capability or cybersecurity action.

label: Decision Maker
description: A role responsible for using security information to make programme or risk decisions.

label: Defence Strategic Objective
description: A Defence strategic objective to which delivered capabilities contribute.

label: Define Roles and Responsibilities
description: Define and assign cybersecurity roles, responsibilities and accountabilities.

label: Define Security Requirements
description: Define security requirements from risk and incorporate them into programme or procurement artefacts.

label: Demonstration
description: Development/demonstration context associated with design, architecture and implementation before or during delivery.

label: Design and Development Security Practice
description: A security principle or practice concerned with design, development or architecture.

label: Develop Attack Scenarios
description: Develop and maintain plausible attack scenarios based on threat-actor objectives.

label: Develop Securely
description: Integrate secure practices throughout capability development and delivery.

label: Development Practice
description: A development practice that may be improved using lessons learned from incidents, exercises or delivery.

label: Disaster Recovery
description: Restore capability and supporting information following disruption.

label: Disaster Recovery Plan
description: A plan for restoring capability or services following disruption.

label: Disposal
description: CADMID Disposal stage or explicit secure-disposal context.

label: Dispose Securely
description: Dispose of assets or capabilities securely in accordance with required procedures and classification rules.

label: Documented Evidence
description: Documented information used to demonstrate or support fulfilment of an SbD requirement.

label: End User
description: A stakeholder role associated with use of the delivered capability.

label: Essential Function
description: A mission- or programme-critical function whose continuity or protection is a key security concern.

label: Essential System
description: A system whose compromise or adverse technological change could affect essential programme functions.

label: Evidence or Assessment Output
description: Evidence produced by monitoring, testing, measurement or assurance assessment.

label: Evidence Record
description: A record or documented evidence item showing that an assurance-relevant activity, event or review occurred.

label: Exercise Recovery
description: Exercise recovery teams and resilience arrangements and use lessons to improve future practice.

label: External Legal, Regulatory or Policy Requirement
description: A legal, regulatory or policy requirement external to the SbD requirement set that a programme must understand or consider.

label: Financial Forecast
description: A financial planning artefact into which cybersecurity resourcing is integrated.

label: Forensic Record
description: Forensic evidence documenting an incident and supporting understanding of what occurred.

label: Function
description: A function performed by or supported by a capability.

label: Govern Cybersecurity
description: Direct and control cybersecurity decision-making across the programme.

label: Governance Activity
description: An activity that directs, coordinates, reviews or communicates cybersecurity governance.

label: Identify or Document Data
description: Identify and document data relevant to programme functioning or threat exposure.

label: Identify Risk
description: Identify cyber risks affecting programme capabilities or essential functions.

label: In-Service
description: CADMID In-Service stage; used where operation, monitoring, incidents, backups, reporting or recovery indicate in-service relevance.

label: Incident
description: A security incident or near miss that triggers review, response, forensics, recovery or lessons learned.

label: Incident Containment
description: Contain or limit the impact of an incident during response.

label: Incident Management Activity
description: An activity used to plan for, contain, analyse, respond to or recover from cybersecurity incidents.

label: Incident Response
description: Prepare for and manage cyber incidents to contain impact and sustain essential functions.

label: Incident Response Plan
description: A maintained and tested plan defining how incidents are handled and integrated with continuity, supply-chain and infrastructure plans.

label: Incident Review Record
description: Documented incident or near-miss review used to understand causes, impacts and lessons.

label: Information Security Service
description: A service providing trusted information-security support, warning, advice, reporting or related community functions.

label: Information Technology (IT)
description: Information technology considered in programme cyber-risk assessment.

label: Infrastructure
description: Physical or digital infrastructure supporting programme delivery, operations, continuity or security.

label: Inherent Risk
description: Risk determined from threat, vulnerability, likelihood and impact before the selected risk response is considered.

label: Insider Threat
description: A threat originating from an insider, explicitly included in socio-technical risk considerations.

label: Integrity
description: Protection of data from unauthorised or undetected alteration.

label: Investment Approval
description: A programme investment approval within which cybersecurity is to be embedded.

label: Invite to Tender Documentation
description: Procurement documentation into which security requirements may be included.

label: Knowledge Asset
description: Knowledge required to support programme or operational activity.

label: Lifecycle Management Activity
description: An activity used to manage assets, people and security through capability life.

label: Lifecycle Security Practice
description: A security practice concerned with secure through-life handling, archival management or disposal.

label: Maintain Data Inventory
description: Maintain and regularly review an inventory of programme data.

label: Make Security Authorisation Decision
description: Enable an accountable risk owner to make an informed decision about risk held by a capability.

label: Manage Assets
description: Maintain through-life management of programme assets in line with policy.

label: Manage Backups
description: Secure, test and make backups available for continuity or recovery.

label: Manage Incident
description: Execute tested incident-management processes to contain impact and maintain essential functions.

label: Manage Security Controls
description: Monitor, report, review and maintain security controls through life.

label: Manage Through Life
description: Manage security, assets, controls, assurance and capability change throughout the lifecycle.

label: Manage Vulnerabilities
description: Systematically understand, assess, manage and improve treatment of vulnerabilities.

label: Managed or Protected Object
description: An object, capability, service, data item, resource or artefact that is managed, protected or referenced by SbD requirements.

label: Manufacture
description: CADMID Manufacture stage; used where component/design/manufacturing applicability is plausible.

label: Mission
description: The mission or mission purpose whose change, essential functions or objectives influence cybersecurity decisions.

label: Monitor Remediation
description: Monitor remediation arising from independent security testing or other assurance activity.

label: Monitor Risk or Effectiveness
description: Monitor security, risk, controls, remediation or resilience and review effectiveness over time.

label: Monitoring and Detection
description: Monitor capabilities to detect or understand security issues throughout life.

label: Monitoring Evidence
description: Evidence from ongoing monitoring of controls, risk, remediations, capabilities or resilience.

label: Normative Element
description: A requirement, principle, criterion, standard or other normative element relevant to MOD Secure by Design.

label: Obsolescence
description: Through-life degradation or ageing that may affect capability effectiveness or security.

label: Obtain Supply Chain Assurance
description: Obtain and manage assurance over supply-chain risk management and flowed-down security expectations.

label: Onboarding or Offboarding
description: Manage personnel entry, role change or exit with security-relevant training and controls.

label: Operational Knowledge
description: Knowledge required by response or recovery personnel such that loss of one individual does not undermine recovery.

label: Operational Resilience Security Practice
description: A security practice concerned with continuity, incident response and recovery.

label: Operational Technology (OT)
description: Operational technology considered in programme cyber-risk assessment.

label: Organisational Concept
description: A programme, person, organisation, role, group or network involved in SbD governance or delivery.

label: Organisational Context
description: The organisational circumstances on which programme cybersecurity strategy is based.

label: Organisational Entity
description: An entity participating in organisational security activity.

label: Organisational Risk Appetite Statement
description: An organisational statement that informs the programme risk appetite.

label: Organisational Unit
description: A team, board, group or management unit within an organisation.

label: Perform Due Diligence
description: Perform cybersecurity planning and due diligence before contracting with a supplier.

label: Personnel Lifecycle Context
description: Personnel onboarding, role change, termination and offboarding context.

label: Plan Incident Response
description: Establish, communicate, maintain, review, test and integrate incident response planning.

label: Plan Risk Response
description: Choose, plan, track and communicate a response to identified risk.

label: Planning Artefact
description: An artefact used to plan, resource or govern programme activity.

label: Post-Incident Operational Norm
description: The intended operational state established through prioritised post-incident recovery actions.

label: Prime Supplier
description: The principal contracted supplier with which MOD conducts planning, due diligence and contractual risk treatment.

label: Prioritise Risk
description: Prioritise risks, improvements, responses or recovery actions.

label: Procurement Artefact
description: An information artefact used in procurement or contracting.

label: Programme Board
description: A governance body that reviews security, risk, performance or through-life management.

label: Programme Sponsor
description: A stakeholder role sponsoring the programme and contributing needs and expectations.

label: Protect Data
description: Apply physical, technical or cryptographic protections to data.

label: Protection and Control Security Practice
description: A security principle or practice concerned with protecting assets, data and vulnerabilities.

label: Recover
description: Restore or sustain essential functions following an incident.

label: Recoverability
description: Ability to restore required capability or functions following an incident.

label: Recovery Plan
description: A documented plan defining selection, scope and prioritisation of post-incident recovery actions.

label: Recovery Preparedness
description: Prepare people, resources, plans and backups for post-incident recovery.

label: Recovery Support Service
description: An external service or support arrangement that augments internal recovery capability.

label: Remediate
description: Implement corrective actions that address weaknesses or improve resilience.

label: Reporting Record
description: A record demonstrating reporting of cyber issues, risks or control status.

label: Residual Cyber Risk
description: Cyber risk remaining after controls or responses, considered against risk appetite for decision-making.

label: Resilience
description: Ability of the capability/programme to withstand, continue through and recover from cyber disruption.

label: Resilience Mechanism
description: A mechanism intended to provide or strengthen cyber resilience and subject to testing or assessment.

label: Resource
description: Time, authority, funding, people or other resources allocated to security delivery, controls or recovery.

label: Resource Gap
description: A shortfall in time, authority, funding or skilled personnel that may create cybersecurity delivery risk.

label: Response Team
description: A team assigned to incident response or recovery activities.

label: Review
description: Review a security artefact, process, role, risk, control or outcome for currency or effectiveness.

label: Review Incidents
description: Review incidents and near misses to understand causes, effects and improvements.

label: Review Record
description: Evidence that an artefact, process, role, risk or control has been reviewed.

label: Review or Test Architecture
description: Review, test, evaluate and improve capability architecture.

label: Risk Appetite
description: The level and type of cyber risk the programme is prepared to accept and use in decision-making.

label: Risk Appetite Statement
description: A documented statement defining organisational or Defence risk appetite.

label: Risk-Based Security
description: Select and manage security decisions in proportion to assessed cyber risk and risk appetite.

label: Risk Communication
description: Conduct structured two-way communication of cybersecurity risks across organisational and supply-chain boundaries.

label: Risk Concept
description: A threat, vulnerability, adverse event, risk, contributor or treatment concept relevant to SbD.

label: Risk Contributor
description: A condition or factor that contributes to cybersecurity risk.

label: Risk Decision Information
description: Information supplied to an accountable risk owner to support an informed risk decision.

label: Risk and Governance Security Practice
description: A security principle or practice concerned with risk-informed governance.

label: Risk Management Activity
description: An activity used to identify, assess, treat, communicate or monitor cyber risk.

label: Risk Management Framework
description: The programme framework into which vulnerability and broader cyber-risk management are integrated.

label: Risk Owner
description: An empowered and accountable role responsible for informed decisions about capability risk.

label: Risk Response
description: The chosen, prioritised, planned, tracked and communicated response to identified risk.

label: Risk Treatment
description: A concept describing the selected response or treatment of identified risk.

label: Role
description: A responsibility-bearing position or function that may be held by a person or organisational entity.

label: Role Redundancy
description: Duplicate critical recovery roles to avoid a personnel single point of failure.

label: Suitably Qualified and Experienced Personnel (SQEP)
description: Personnel possessing the cybersecurity knowledge, skills, experience and authority required for relevant work.

label: SbD Criterion
description: An official source criterion/evidence-area used to organise SbD requirements.

label: SbD Principle
description: An official MOD Secure by Design principle grouping related criteria and requirements.

label: SbD Requirement
description: An official MOD Secure by Design requirement represented with its source identifier and exact wording.

label: Secure Acquisition
description: Build cybersecurity considerations into acquisition, contractual and lifecycle processes.

label: Secure by Design
description: Security is integrated into capability and programme decisions from the outset rather than added later.

label: Secure Development
description: Integrate and monitor secure development practices throughout delivery.

label: Secure Disposal
description: Apply security controls and classification rules when disposing of assets or capabilities.

label: Security Artefact
description: A documented cybersecurity strategy, plan, assessment, inventory or other structured security artefact.

label: Security Authorisation Decision
description: An informed decision by an accountable risk owner about the cyber risk held by a capability.

label: Security Awareness
description: Personnel awareness of security and privacy responsibilities, measured for effectiveness.

label: Security Awareness Measurement
description: Evidence of security-awareness effectiveness based on behavioural impact rather than attendance alone.

label: Security Control
description: A control selected, monitored, reviewed or resourced to manage cybersecurity risk.

label: Security Engineering Activity
description: An activity used to define, develop, implement, protect, test or improve security in a capability.

label: Security Governance
description: Govern cybersecurity decisions, roles, escalation and performance through accountable programme structures.

label: Security Management Concept
description: An abstract management concept used to govern cybersecurity decisions, risk, controls or awareness.

label: Security Reporting
description: Report security issues, risks, status or control information through defined reporting channels.

label: Security Requirement
description: A normative cybersecurity requirement applying to a programme, capability, asset, activity or stakeholder.

label: Security Requirement Flow-Down
description: Propagate security requirements and risk-appetite expectations through supplier tiers.

label: Security Testing and Verification
description: Practice of testing and verifying security or resilience expectations.

label: Security Working Group
description: A governance group used to manage, coordinate and communicate cybersecurity decisions and risks.

label: Select Security Controls
description: Select controls appropriate to capability delivery, assessed risk and risk appetite.

label: Senior Management
description: A senior leadership role to which significant cybersecurity analysis may be escalated.

label: Senior Responsible Owner
description: A senior accountable role that may define risk appetite or act as a risk owner.

label: Single Point of Failure
description: A dependency on a single role or resource whose loss could undermine recovery capability.

label: Social Engineering
description: Manipulative attack techniques targeting people, explicitly included in socio-technical risk.

label: Socio-Technical Risk
description: Risk arising from interacting technical, human, organisational, policy and workflow factors.

label: Socio-Technical Security
description: Treat cyber risk as arising from interacting technical, human, organisational and process factors.

label: Specialist Cyber Responder
description: A specialist external or internal role that augments cyber incident recovery capability.

label: Specification
description: A technical or procurement specification into which security requirements may be incorporated.

label: Stakeholder Need or Expectation
description: A stakeholder need or expectation to be understood and considered in cybersecurity risk management.

label: Stakeholder Role
description: A role held by a party with needs, expectations, responsibilities or decision interests in the programme or capability.

label: Stored Data
description: Data held at rest and requiring appropriate physical or technical protection.

label: Supplier Organisation
description: An external organisation supplying goods, services, support or resources to a programme.

label: Supply Chain
description: The network of supplier organisations involved in providing capabilities, systems, services or support.

label: Supply Chain Assurance Evidence
description: Evidence that supplier risk management, flowed-down security requirements and risk appetite expectations are addressed.

label: Supply Chain Risk Management
description: Manage cybersecurity risk and security expectations across the supplier chain.

label: Supply-Chain Security Practice
description: A security practice concerned with acquisition and supplier-chain risk.

label: Technological Change Risk
description: Risk arising from technological developments or changes that may adversely affect essential systems or invalidate prior assessments.

label: Technology
description: Technology used or anticipated in delivering capabilities and considered in risk assessment.

label: Test Security or Resilience
description: Test security or resilience mechanisms, processes, plans or controls.

label: Testing Evidence
description: Evidence produced by security, resilience, process, plan or backup testing.

label: Third Party
description: An external party handling data, providing services or introducing cyber risk outside the immediate programme organisation.

label: Threat Assessment
description: A documented or maintained assessment of relevant cyber threats and their implications.

label: Threat Assumption
description: An explicit assumption about relevant threats used as a basis for risk assessment.

label: Threat-Informed Security
description: Base security decisions and assessments on explicit and current threat understanding.

label: Threat Intelligence
description: Information about evolving threats or external incidents used to update threat assessments and security decisions.

label: Threat Assessment and Modelling Activity
description: An activity used to assess threats, analyse adversarial perspectives or construct attack scenarios.

label: Threat Modelling
description: Represent plausible adversarial objectives, methods and system perspectives to understand attack possibilities.

label: Through-Life Management Plan
description: A programme plan for management of capabilities and security through life.

label: Tier 1 Supplier
description: A first-tier supplier within the supply-chain assurance scope.

label: Tier 2 Supplier
description: A second-tier supplier within the supply-chain assurance scope.

label: Tier 3 Supplier
description: A third-tier supplier within the supply-chain assurance scope.

label: Traceability
description: Ability to trace security decisions, artefacts, data, actions or evidence through documented records.

label: Train Personnel
description: Provide, maintain or demonstrate role-relevant security, disposal, response or recovery training.

label: Transmission Path
description: A path by which data is transmitted, for which alternatives may support resilience.

label: Understand Context
description: Establish and maintain understanding of relevant mission, organisational, operational, data or risk context.

label: Update
description: Update a security artefact, assessment or process in response to change.

label: Upgrade
description: Change or improve a capability during its through-life management.

label: Vulnerability
description: A weakness that may be exploited and must be understood, assessed and managed.

label: Vulnerability Management
description: Systematically identify, assess, manage and improve treatment of vulnerabilities.

label: Vulnerability Management Activity
description: An activity used to understand, assess, remediate or monitor vulnerabilities.

label: addresses security property
description: Links an SbD requirement to a security property or objective that the requirement explicitly or inferentially seeks to protect or achieve.

label: agreed by
description: Identifies the stakeholder role or organisational body that agrees a risk appetite or cybersecurity decision.

label: applies during
description: Relates a requirement or activity to the lifecycle context in which it applies.

label: assesses
description: Relates an assessment or review activity to the risk, vulnerability, asset, architecture, resilience concern or other domain element being assessed.

label: augmented by
description: Indicates that a capability's recovery capacity can be increased by an external recovery-support service.

label: based on
description: Relates an artefact, assessment or decision to contextual information, assumptions or source material on which it is based.

label: communicates to
description: Relates security information, a decision or a communication activity to the organisational recipient.

label: considers
description: Indicates that an assessment, design or management activity considers a context, risk, stakeholder need, asset or other relevant factor.

label: contributes to risk
description: Indicates that a threat, vulnerability or other risk concept contributes to the determination or existence of a risk.

label: criterion belongs to principle
description: Associates an official SbD criterion with the SbD principle under which that criterion is defined.

label: defined by
description: Identifies the role or organisational body that defines a risk appetite, artefact or governance element.

label: escalates to
description: Relates analysis, findings or security information to a higher governance role or body to which it is escalated.

label: expresses security practice
description: Links an SbD requirement to a cybersecurity principle or practice expressed by the requirement.

label: feeds back into
description: Indicates that lessons, evidence or learning from an activity feeds into programme practice, development practice or future planning.

label: flows down to
description: Represents propagation of security requirements or risk appetite through suppliers or the supply chain.

label: has atomic clause
description: Links an official SbD requirement to an analytical atomic requirement clause candidate derived from it.

label: has evidence expectation
description: Relates an SbD requirement to evidence, documentation, records, plans or other assurance artefacts expected by that requirement.

label: has need or expectation
description: Associates a stakeholder role with a stakeholder need or expectation relevant to the capability or programme.

label: has responsible role
description: Associates a requirement, activity, risk or artefact with the role accountable or responsible for it.

label: impacts
description: Indicates an adverse or consequential effect of a risk, threat, compromise or change on a managed object, function or organisational concept.

label: included in
description: Indicates that a security requirement or security-management element is included in a contract, specification, plan or procurement artefact.

label: informed by
description: Indicates that an assessment, risk appetite, decision or improvement activity is informed by threat, incident, intelligence or other information.

label: integrates with
description: Indicates integration of one activity, plan, framework or security-management element with another.

label: involves organisational concept
description: Links an SbD requirement to an actor, role, organisation, programme, group or other organisational concept involved in the requirement.

label: maintains
description: Relates an actor or activity to an artefact, managed object or security-management concept that it keeps current or operational.

label: manages
description: Relates a management activity or organisational concept to risk, vulnerability, assets, controls, suppliers or lifecycle concerns it manages.

label: mitigates
description: Indicates that a control, activity or assurance/procurement artefact reduces a risk or limits the impact of an adverse security event.

label: performed by
description: Identifies the role, organisation, team or programme context that performs an activity.

label: prevents
description: Indicates that a security activity or control is intended to prevent an adverse security event, vulnerability exploitation or failure.

label: produces
description: Relates an activity to an information artefact, evidence item, record or assessment output that it generates.

label: provides understanding of
description: Relates a forensic activity or forensic record to the incident, compromise or other risk concept it helps explain.

label: reports to
description: Relates a reporting activity or organisational participant to an organisational reporting point or information-security service.

label: reviewed by
description: Identifies the role or organisational body that reviews an artefact, process, risk or outcome.

label: reviews
description: Associates a role or organisational body with an artefact, process, risk or outcome it reviews.

label: role responsible for
description: Associates a role with a requirement, activity, risk or artefact for which the role is responsible or accountable.

label: supports
description: Indicates that a process, control, activity, resource or managed object supports a function, decision, objective or other capability concern.

label: tests
description: Relates a testing or assurance activity to the plan, mechanism, backup, architecture, process or other subject being tested.

label: updated for
description: Relates an artefact or assessment to a mission, threat, context or technological change that causes or justifies an update.

label: behavioural impact
description: Records the observed or assessed behavioural impact associated with a security-awareness measurement.

label: capability effectiveness
description: Records a qualitative or quantitative expression of capability effectiveness where the SbD source requires it to be understood or reviewed.

label: impact
description: Records an impact value or descriptor associated with a risk, incident or cyber-risk assessment.

label: is community-based service
description: Indicates whether an information-security service is community-based.

label: is trusted service
description: Indicates whether an information-security service is treated as trusted in the SbD assurance context.

label: likelihood
description: Records the likelihood value or descriptor used in risk assessment.

label: parent requirement identifier
description: Stores the Parent Requirement ID preserved from the requirements spreadsheet for an official SbD requirement.

label: reference value
description: Stores the link, URI, document reference or other locator represented by an Artefact Reference.

label: source identifier
description: Stores the authoritative source identifier for a normative element, such as SbD_01, DSTL-SbD01-Criterion_01 or DSTL-SbD01-C1-R1.

label: source text
description: Stores the exact authoritative requirement wording or analytical clause text without silent rewriting.

label: source title
description: Stores the source title or short name associated with a normative element where the source provides one.

description: Associates a requirement element or activity with a SORA-derived lifecycle or operational context.

label: hasRequirementClassification
description: Classifies a requirement element as Annex E safety or Cyber Extension cyber-safety/security.

label: hasRobustnessLevel
description: Associates a SORA requirement element with its Low, Medium, or High source robustness-column value. Not Required (NR) is represented separately by isRequiredForSAIL on OSORobustnessAssignment.

label: madeBy
description: Links an assurance statement or claim to the actor that makes it.

label: permitsDeclaration
description: Links a SORA Assurance requirement to the Declaration form of assurance explicitly permitted by the source.

label: requiredAtSAIL
description: Associates a requirement element with the SAIL level or levels for which the source table makes it applicable.

label: requiresAssuranceArtifact
description: Links an Assurance requirement to an assurance artefact or statement required or accepted to substantiate the specified level of assurance.

label: supportedByEvidence
description: Links an AssuranceClaim to evidence that supports the claim.

label: validatedBy
description: Links an assurance artefact, procedure, programme, training artefact, mechanism, or claim to the actor role that validates it.

label: verifiedBy
description: Links an assurance object, competence, procedure, control, or claim to the actor role that verifies it.

label: clauseOrder
description: Stores the controlled order of an official clause within its parent criterion.

label: isRequiredForSAIL
description: States whether a particular OSO robustness assignment is required for the given SAIL. False represents an NR assignment and therefore no robustness level is required.

label: sailOrdinal
description: Stores the ordinal position of a SAIL value from I through VI for ordering/query support.
